name: Bai Sha Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Bai Sha Technology Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive range of print products and services, serving both the domestic market in Taiwan and an international client base. The company's diverse portfolio features various packaging solutions, including vibrant color boxes, transparent polypropylene boxes, and custom bags. It also specializes in numerous book formats such as durable hardcover, flexible paperback, saddle-stitched, glue-bound, and loose-leaf publications. Additional offerings include essential corporate stationery like business cards, envelopes, letterheads, official document covers, presentation folders, triangular desk calendars, and exclusive VIP cards. Bai Sha further provides custom color and shaped stickers, alongside automated labeling services. Its promotional materials segment covers invitation cards, detailed catalogs, striking posters, large-format image output, practical display stands, and unique paper fans. Beyond manufacturing, the company furnishes specialized print finishing techniques, including sophisticated cold foil printing, various surface treatments, meticulous prepress proofing, and distinctive 3D embossing. Established in 1989, Bai Sha Technology's main operations are based in Taichung City, Taiwan.
